summary: Shoe Station Group filed an 8-K on Oct. 15, 2026, reporting a First Amendment to its Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with Wells Fargo as administrative agent. The $100 million revolving facility maturity extends to Oct. 15, 2031, with revised pricing (Base Rate plus 0.00%-1.00% or Adjusted Term SOFR plus 1.00%-2.00%), commitment fees of 0.20%-0.30%, a $40 million restricted-payment basket, and $35 million headquarters secured-debt capacity. No equity, M&A, or special-situation event; watch leverage-based pricing and covenant baskets.
